hero.title: Soplos Layout Switcher
hero.description: Switches the GNOME Shell desktop between predefined layouts.

about.tagline: Switches the GNOME Shell desktop between predefined layouts.

layouts.saveBody: It saves the extensions that are on now, their settings and the window buttons, as a layout of your own that you can apply again.
layouts.deleteBody: Delete the layout {name}? This cannot be undone.
layouts.replaceBody: A layout called {name} already exists. Replace it with the desktop as it is now?

steps.ensuring: Checking the extensions the layout needs.
steps.packagesFailed: The packages could not be installed.
steps.installedBundled: Extension {arg} installed from the one that ships with the program.
steps.noBuild: extensions.gnome.org has no build of {arg} for this version of the shell.
steps.manual: These extensions have to be installed by hand: {arg}. The extensions manager is opening.
steps.settingFailed: The setting {arg} could not be changed.
steps.enableFailed: Extension {arg} could not be turned on yet. Reload the desktop so the shell finds it.
steps.saveFailed: The chosen layout could not be saved.
steps.loggingOut: Closing the session to reload the desktop.
steps.tooBig: The settings of the extensions are too large to be saved.

errors.title: Could not be completed
errors.apply: The layout could not be applied.
errors.reload: The desktop could not be reloaded.
errors.tool: The tool could not be opened.
errors.switch: The extension could not be changed.
errors.save: The layout could not be saved.
errors.name: The name can have letters, digits, spaces and . , _ - up to 40 characters.
errors.delete: The layout could not be deleted.

notices.title: Notice
notices.applied: The layout {name} is applied. If the desktop does not look right yet, use Reload Desktop.
notices.appliedNotes: The layout {name} is applied, but some things need your attention.
notices.saved: The layout {name} is saved. It is now in the list.
